title: Fluency (Theme 8: Domestic animals)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child asks "Does that make sense? Does it match the letters?" and rereads the sentence.
steps: Read a sentence with a planted mistake.
The child reads and fixes own mistakes.
Praise the fix, not only the right reading.

board.do: Write: The cow is in the horse.
Wait for the child to notice.
The child writes the right word above.
Read: The cow is in the house.

listen_for: Amina put on her shoots. (and goes on)
misconceptions.repair: Go back and read it again.

misconceptions.ask: Is this a word we know by sight?
misconceptions.repair: The, said, was: just read them.

listen_for: stops and looks at the teacher

checks.question: The teacher reads "Amina put on her shoots." What should Amina do?
